label: EXPLORATORY / NOT CONFIRMATORY / NOT PROMOTABLE
stabilized_variant_note: EXPLORATORY comparison only (stronger ridge + pred_floor=1e-8); does NOT replace prereg A-E contrasts or change confirmatory estimands.

alignment_checks.train_only_normalization: wf.apply_train_only_normalization used per split before fit (scripts/run_funding_ablations.py run_multisplit); scaler fit on train only.
alignment_checks.funding_last_known_alignment: src.features.funding.resample_funding_to_hourly uses reindex(method='ffill') on sorted funding aligned to kline index => last known at/before hour; no backward fill.
alignment_checks.trailing_stats_past_only: ff.trailing_funding_pct/zscore use rolling/past windows over already-aligned series; no future leakage by construction.
alignment_checks.prediction_floor_primary: fit_predict_ols floors predictions at 0.0 after OLS; paired QLIKE masks require p>0 and y>0 so floored-to-zero are excluded but near-zero positives can inflate QLIKE (y/p).
alignment_checks.e_vs_a_note: E adds funding_signed, funding_abs, funding_pct_*, funding_z_*; LOO and stabilized comparison reported as EXPLORATORY only.
